info.title: Racha API
info.description: Accounts, sync and statistics for the Racha apps (spec §7). The server never stores or serves media.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Server state, users, backups, logs and mail; admins only

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Accounts and sessions: email + password, JWT access token, rotating refresh token

tags.name: Sync
tags.description: Batches of local changes up, remote changes since a cursor down; last writer wins

tags.name: Web session
tags.description: Sign-in for the web panel: refresh token in an HttpOnly cookie
